lines.en: label day282:
scene nodokaotohapark1
Nodoka and I make our way across town after[school] in hopes of meeting up with Otoha.
lines.zh: 放学后，Nodoka 和我穿城而过，希望能和 Otoha 碰上面。

lines.en: Rin was supposed to come as well, but she apparently forgot that she had a doctor's appointment today.
lines.zh: Rin 本来也该一起来的，不过她显然忘了自己今天预约了医生。

lines.en: I’m fine with this of course, as it means I’ll finally get to be alone with Nodoka.
lines.zh: 我当然没意见，因为这意味着我终于能和 Nodoka 独处了。

lines.en: But I guess I’m mildly surprised by how open she was to this instead of just deciding to postpone the excursion.
lines.zh: 不过我大概有点意外，她竟然这么爽快，而不是干脆把这次出行推迟。

lines.en: Then again, Uta also did something similar shortly after transferring in.
lines.zh: 话说回来，Uta 转进来之后不久也做过类似的事。

lines.en: And as much as I want to say that those two are just looking to get closer to me, the logical thing to think would be that they’re going out on a limb for their friends.
lines.zh: 虽然我很想说她们俩只是想和我更亲近，但合乎逻辑的想法应该是她们在为朋友两肋插刀。

lines.en: {i}Or{/i} that they’re going out on a limb for their friends but also want to be alone with me.
lines.zh: {i}或{/i}者她们既是为朋友两肋插刀，同时也想和我独处。

lines.en: This is the most exciting answer, so it is the one that I will go with.
lines.zh: 这个答案最让人兴奋，所以我就选它了。

lines.en: : Don’t you think you should be wearing something a little warmer given the weather, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 看这天气，你不觉得该穿得暖和点吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : I’ll have you know this is the thickest T-shirt money can buy at one very specific store in one very specific location.
lines.zh: : 我得告诉你，这可是在某个非常特定的地方、某家非常特定的店里，能买到的最厚的 T 恤了。

lines.en: : And shouldn’t you be drinking something a little warmer than bottled water?
lines.zh: : 还有，你是不是也该喝点比瓶装水热乎的东西？

lines.en: : Probably. But this is what I have, so this is what I’ll drink.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。不过我只有这个，所以就喝这个了。

lines.en: : Would you like a sip?
lines.zh: : 你要来一口吗？

lines.en: : I’m good, thanks.
lines.zh: : 不用了，谢谢。

lines.en: : Afraid to share an indirect kiss with someone you just met?
lines.zh: : 怕和刚认识的人间接接吻吗？

lines.en: : No. I’m just not some maniac who walks around in the snow drinking something that will likely be frozen before we even make it back home.
lines.zh: : 不是。我只是不是那种会在雪地里走来走去、喝着一杯很可能在我们到家前就冻上的东西的疯子。

lines.en: scene nodokaotohapark2
: Of course you’re not a maniac. You’re a completely normal adult accompanying a [young_girl] miles away to meet up with another [young_girl] and potentially kidnap her.
lines.zh: : 你当然不是疯子。你只是个完全正常的成年人，陪着一个[young_girl]走上好几公里，去见另一个[young_girl]，还可能把她绑架了。

lines.en: : Well it definitely doesn’t sound normal when you put it like that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，被你这么一说，听起来确实不太正常。

lines.en: scene nodokaotohapark3
: It doesn’t need to sound normal.
lines.zh: : 它不需要听起来正常。

lines.en: : In fact, nothing needs to sound normal.
lines.zh: : 事实上，什么事情都不需要听起来正常。

lines.en: : The most exciting parts of life are the ones you wouldn’t possibly be able to recreate even if you tried your hardest.
lines.zh: : 人生中最精彩的部分，是那些哪怕你拼尽全力也无法重现的部分。

lines.en: : This is the first and last time the two of us will ever come to this park in the snow to pull someone out of the pits of despair.
lines.zh: : 这是我们俩第一次、也是最后一次在雪天来到这个公园，把一个人从绝望的深渊里拉出来。

lines.en: : I think that makes today a beautiful day.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这让今天成了美好的一天。

lines.en: : Yeah, but you can be that specific about anything and make it sound more special than it actually is.
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过你可以对任何事都描述得那么具体，让它听起来比实际更特别。

lines.en: scene nodokaotohapark4
: That’s my job, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 那就是我的工作啊，Sensei。

lines.en: : Otoha’s as well.
lines.zh: : Otoha 的工作也是。

lines.en: : We’re just two cute girls who find interesting ways to rearrange words or sounds, and yet we’re regarded as geniuses by many of our peers.
lines.zh: : 我们不过是两个可爱的女孩，擅长用有趣的方式重新排列文字或声音，却被许多同龄人当成天才。

lines.en: : It’s rather silly, I think. How people are quicker to give up and praise others rather than attempt to obtain said praise on their own.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这挺蠢的。人们宁愿更快地放弃、去赞美别人，也不愿试着自己去赢得那份赞美。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. So you’re one of those cool geniuses who pretends to {i}not{/i} be a genius because being praised is troublesome.
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。所以你是那种假装自己{i}不是{/i}天才的酷天才，因为被夸奖很麻烦。

lines.en: : Perhaps. Or perhaps I just want people to view me for who I really am rather than what I write.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。或者我只是想让人们看到真正的我，而不是我写的东西。

lines.en: : Who are you then?
lines.zh: : 那你是什么人？

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : The [incest]uous haiku girl, I suppose?
lines.zh: : 大概就是那个[incest]的俳句女孩？

lines.en: : I feel like you have access to a lot more words that probably would have been better there.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你肚子里肯定有更多更合适的词可以用在那儿。

lines.en: : And yet I chose the ones I liked the most instead of choosing the ones you expected. Bam, genius.
lines.zh: : 可我偏偏选了我最喜欢的那些，而不是你期待的那些。啪，天才。

lines.en: : You’re weird.
lines.zh: : 你真怪。

lines.en: : So are you.
lines.zh: : 你也是。

lines.en: : Want to make out?
lines.zh: : 想接吻吗？

lines.en: : Sure. Aren’t we on a mission, though?
lines.zh: : 好啊。不过我们不是在执行任务吗？

lines.en: : I wasn’t being serious.
lines.zh: : 我不是认真的。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well shit.
lines.zh: : 哦，操。

lines.en: scene nodokaotohapark5
: On the bright side, this confirms that you really {i}weren’t{/i} afraid of the indirect kiss, though.
lines.zh: : 不过往好处想，这证明你还真{i}不怕{/i}间接接吻。

lines.en: : I award you five more Nodoka points for your bravery, which brings you to a total of ten.
lines.zh: : 为你的勇气，我再奖励你五个 Nodoka 点数，这样你就有十个了。

lines.en: : How many more until we can make out?
lines.zh: : 还要多少点才能接吻？

lines.en: : Five thousand.
lines.zh: : 五千。

lines.en: : That is way too many points. You better be really good at making out.
lines.zh: : 这也太多了。那你最好吻技真的很好。

lines.en: scene nodokaotohapark6
: I think it's a fair amount of points.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这个点数挺合理的。

lines.en: : If you’re earning an average of five per day, you’re currently on pace to finish just under three years from now.
lines.zh: : 如果你平均每天赚五个，按你现在的速度，不到三年后就能攒够了。

lines.en: : It would probably be safer to engage in a tryst with a senior anyway. Chin up, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 反正和学姐偷情大概更安全些。打起精神来，Sensei。

lines.en: : You’re so weird.
lines.zh: : 你太怪了。

lines.en: : I suppose I am.
lines.zh: : 我想是的。

lines.en: : But I’m more suited to the role of a matchmaker anyway.
lines.zh: : 不过我本来就更适合作媒人这个角色。

lines.en: : Or perhaps a seer.
lines.zh: : 或者说是观察者。

lines.en: : To observe the dynamics between others.
lines.zh: : 去观察人与人之间的互动。

lines.en: : To write them down.
lines.zh: : 然后把它们写下来。

lines.en: : And to get really raunchy with all of the explicit details because sex sells.
lines.zh: : 再把所有露骨的细节写得极其下流，因为性才能卖钱。

lines.en: : Such is the mission of the [incest]uous haiku girl.
lines.zh: : 这就是那个[incest]的俳句女孩的使命。

lines.en: : So anyway, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 那么言归正传，Otoha。

lines.en: scene nodokaotohapark7
: Right, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 对，Otoha。

lines.en: : We’re not far from her usual spot.
lines.zh: : 我们离她常待的地方不远了。

lines.en: : She’s extremely predictable, unlike yours truly.
lines.zh: : 她极其好预测，不像我。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ll wind up being plenty predictable soon enough.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，你很快也会变得很好预测的。

lines.en: : I’m normally pretty good at figuring people out, I think.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我通常挺擅长看透别人的。

lines.en: : I suppose we’ll just have to wait and find out how true that is, then.
lines.zh: : 那我们就等着看这话有几分真吧。

lines.en: : I’m not opposed to the idea of someone being able to truly understand me when no one really has before.
lines.zh: : 我并不排斥有某个人能真正理解我——毕竟以前从来没有人做到过。

lines.en: : I don’t know how fond I am of that person being my teacher, but I suppose it would make my life more like something out of a novel.
lines.zh: : 我不知道我会不会喜欢那个人是我的老师，不过我想那会让我的生活更像小说里的情节。

lines.en: : And just think of how many Nodoka points you could earn if you started {i}really{/i} getting it.
lines.zh: : 再想想，如果你{i}真的{/i}开始懂我了，你能赚到多少 Nodoka 点数啊。

lines.en: : We’ll be making out in no time at all.
lines.zh: : 那我们很快就能接吻了。

lines.en: : Tack an extra thousand points on and I might let you play with my breasts.
lines.zh: : 再加一千点，我也许会让你玩我的胸部。

lines.en: : Might? That doesn’t sound like a good use of my Nodoka points. I need a manufacturer guarantee.
lines.zh: : 也许？这听起来不太像是我 Nodoka 点数的好用法。我要求厂家提供质保。

lines.en: : Apologies, but providing guarantees and refunds goes against company policy.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，但提供质保和退款有违公司政策。

lines.en: : All points are to be used at the sole discretion of the consumer and I will not be held liable for any problems that may occur as a result of their misuse.
lines.zh: : 所有点数均由消费者自行决定如何使用，因误用而引发的任何问题，我概不负责。

lines.en: : I hope your currency tanks and you’re forced to accept real money instead.
lines.zh: : 我希望你的货币崩盘，逼得你只能收真钱。

lines.en: : Do you think you could afford me if that happens?
lines.zh: : 如果真有那一天，你觉得你养得起我吗？

lines.en: : How much do you think you’re worth?
lines.zh: : 你觉得你值多少？

lines.en: : I’ll tell you exactly how much I think I’d be worth for three hundred Nodoka points.
lines.zh: : 只要三百个 Nodoka 点数，我就告诉你我觉得自己值多少。

lines.en: : Let me get back to you in 58 days.
lines.zh: : 我 58 天后再答复你。

lines.en: scene black
if cafe35 == True:
Nodoka and I make our way down the stairs of the overpass we’ve been walking on and wind up inside of the same park where I first met Otoha.
lines.zh: Nodoka 和我走下我们一路走来的天桥台阶，最后来到了我第一次见到 Otoha 的那个公园。

lines.en: else:
Nodoka and I make our way down the stairs of the overpass we’ve been walking on and wind up inside of some trendy looking park.
lines.zh: Nodoka 和我走下我们一路走来的天桥台阶，最后走进了一个看起来挺时髦的公园。

lines.en: There isn’t a lot of foot traffic on account of the weather, but there are a few passersby I take note of on my way down the steps.
lines.zh: 因为天气的缘故，行人不多，不过我下台阶的路上还是留意到了几个路人。

lines.en: I watch them toss coins into a fountain in the center, wondering what it is they could be wishing for.
lines.zh: 我看着他们往中央的喷泉里扔硬币，好奇他们到底在许什么愿。

lines.en: And then I start to wonder what I would wish for if I had any coins on me.
lines.zh: 然后我开始想，如果我身上有硬币，我会许什么愿。

lines.en: I can’t think of anything.
lines.zh: 我什么都想不出来。

lines.en: scene nodokaotohapark8
: Nodoka?
lines.zh: : Nodoka？

lines.en: : What are you doing over here? I thought you transferred?
lines.zh: : 你在这儿干什么？我还以为你转学了呢？

lines.en: : I’m just here to help a bird with broken wings out of its cage.
lines.zh: : 我只是来把一只断了翅膀的鸟从笼子里救出去的。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : I’m here to rescue you.
lines.zh: : 我是来救你的。

lines.en: scene nodokaotohapark9
: And so is he.
lines.zh: : 他也是。

lines.en: : Yo.
: You? Aren’t you Rin’s teacher?
lines.zh: : 你？你不是 Rin 的老师吗？

lines.en: : I’m also Nodoka’s new boyfriend.
lines.zh: : 我还是 Nodoka 的新男友。

lines.en: scene nodokaotohapark10
: That's right.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : And we want you to be there for our first time.
lines.zh: : 而且我们想让你来见证我们的第一次。

lines.en: : That's the real reason we came to see you.
lines.zh: : 这才是我们来找你的真正原因。

lines.en: : Uhh...first time as in...
lines.zh: : 呃……第一次是指……

lines.en: : I understand that it might not sound exciting simply {i}being{/i} there, so I’m offering to share his body with you.
lines.zh: : 我明白光是{i}在场{/i}听起来可能不够刺激，所以我愿意把他身体分你一半。

lines.en: : But only this once. After that, you can continue to watch, but-
lines.zh: : 不过仅限这一次。之后你还可以继续看，不过——

lines.en: scene nodokaotohapark11
: She’s joking, right?
lines.zh: : 她是在开玩笑吧？

lines.en: : Because it would be messed up if you came all the way over here to invite me to some...weird threesome.
lines.zh: : 因为如果你们大老远跑过来是为了邀请我参加什么……奇怪的三人行，那也太变态了。

lines.en: : I’ll actually let Nodoka explain why we’re here since I don’t really get it yet.
lines.zh: : 其实我让 Nodoka 来解释我们为什么来这儿吧，因为我自己都还没搞明白。

lines.en: scene nodokaotohapark12
: Oh, look. A bird that I will proceed to stare at for the next ten minutes as you rescue this one from its cage.
lines.zh: : 哦，你看。那边有只鸟，接下来十分钟我就要盯着它看了，而你就负责把这只从笼子里救出来。

lines.en: : Have fun explaining everything, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 祝你解释得开心，Sensei。

lines.en: : It would probably be easier for you to just tell me. We’re not getting anything out of Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 大概还是你直接告诉我会更简单些。我们从 Nodoka 嘴里是问不出什么的。

lines.en: : I see that...
lines.zh: : 我看出来了……

lines.en: : This would have been a lot easier if Rin came.
lines.zh: : 如果 Rin 来了会容易得多。

lines.en: : She had a doctor’s appointment or something today, right?
lines.zh: : 她今天约了医生还是什么的，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah. I guess that means you two are still talking regularly?
lines.zh: : 是啊。看来你们俩还在经常联系？

lines.en: scene nodokaotohapark13
: Regularly is kind of an understatement when she messages me like ten thousand times a day.
lines.zh: : 她一天给我发一万条消息，「经常」这个词都有点保守了。

lines.en: : Yeah...she can get like that.
lines.zh: : 是啊……她有时候就是那样。

lines.en: : It doesn’t look like you mind, though.
lines.zh: : 不过看起来你并不介意。

lines.en: : Nah. I thought it was a little weird at first, but she’s grown on me.
lines.zh: : 没。一开始我觉得有点怪，不过我越来越喜欢她了。

lines.en: : Kinda like a...puppy waiting for its master to come home and-
lines.zh: : 有点像……一只等着主人回家的小狗，然后——

lines.en: scene nodokaotohapark14
: Ew. That probably made me sound really weird, didn’t it?
lines.zh: : 呃。这话听起来肯定很怪吧？

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure it would make her the happiest girl in the world.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，这话会让她成为全世界最幸福的女孩。

lines.en: scene nodokaotohapark15
: Hahah...yeah. Probably.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……是啊。大概是吧。

lines.en: : I’m sure you didn’t come all the way here just to talk about Rin, though. Right?
lines.zh: : 不过你们肯定不是大老远跑来就为了聊 Rin 吧？对吧？

lines.en: : Is this about transferring?
lines.zh: : 是为了转学的事吗？

lines.en: : Oh, so you {i}do{/i} know what’s going on.
lines.zh: : 哦，看来你知道{i}是{/i}怎么回事了。

lines.en: : Well considering Nodoka and Rin have both been bothering me about it constantly, yeah. I think I get what's going on now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，考虑到 Nodoka 和 Rin 一直在不停地烦我，是啊。我想我现在搞明白是怎么回事了。

lines.en: : I don’t really know, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我也不是很确定。

lines.en: : I was doing okay in my last[school], but I’m not that great with change. And one wrong move could like, really mess up what I have going for me right now.
lines.zh: : 我上一所[school]念得还行，但我不太擅长应对变化。而且一步走错，真的可能把我现在的优势全毁了。

lines.en: : What do you have going for you right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在的优势是什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Freedom, I guess?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。自由吧，大概？

lines.en: : I don’t know if I’d call having your spare time entirely dependent on whether or not you get good grades “freedom.”
lines.zh: : 如果你的空余时间完全取决于你能不能拿到好成绩，我可不觉得那能叫「自由」。

lines.en: scene nodokaotohapark16
: Well, yeah...But it makes sense.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是啊……不过这说得通啊。

lines.en: : Shouldn’t a student’s primary objective be getting good grades or whatever?
lines.zh: : 学生的首要目标难道不就是拿好成绩什么的吗？

lines.en: : And like, if your grades suck, obviously you should be spending less time doing what you want to do and studying instead.
lines.zh: : 而且，如果成绩烂，你显然就该少花时间做想做的事，多去学习。

lines.en: : Or, alternatively, what if you were spending {i}all{/i} of your time doing the things you want to do?
lines.zh: : 或者换个思路——如果你把{i}所有{/i}时间都花在做自己想做的事情上呢？

lines.en: : You’d...probably fail and get held back.
lines.zh: : 你……大概会挂科然后留级吧。

lines.en: : What are you getting at?
lines.zh: : 你到底想说什么？

lines.en: : Transfer into my class and you can do whatever you want, whenever you want.
lines.zh: : 转到我的班上来，你想做什么就做什么，想什么时候做就什么时候做。

lines.en: scene nodokaotohapark17
: Wait! That makes it sound like you’re teaching some like, music class or something. That's not true, is it?
lines.zh: : 等等！这听起来像是你在教什么……音乐课之类的。不是吧？

lines.en: : The real answer is a lot less...interesting.
lines.zh: : 真正的答案可就没那么……有意思了。

lines.en: : I just mean that I hate teaching, so I give everyone straight A’s so I don’t have to do anything.
lines.zh: : 我的意思只是我讨厌教书，所以我给所有人全 A，这样我就什么都不用干。

lines.en: : Is that even legal?
lines.zh: : 这合法吗？

lines.en: : Who knows?
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢？

lines.en: : But the point is, I’d be willing to do that same exact thing for you since you are the most highly-requested student I’ve had so far.
lines.zh: : 不过重点是，我愿意为你做一模一样的事，因为你是到目前为止被点名要得最多的学生。

lines.en: : But only Nodoka and Rin have requested me.
lines.zh: : 可只有 Nodoka 和 Rin 要过我啊。

lines.en: : Noriko Nakayama as well. All three of them bombarded me in my office after[school] yesterday asking me to do this.
lines.zh: : 还有 Noriko Nakayama。昨天放学后她们三个在我办公室里对我轮番轰炸，要我这么做。

lines.en: scene nodokaotohapark18
: Noriko is there too?! That’s crazy!
lines.zh: : Noriko 也在那儿？！太离谱了吧！

lines.en: : How the hell did you wind up with three of the coolest people I know?
lines.zh: : 你到底是怎么把我认识的最酷的三个人都弄到手的？

lines.en: : Probably because I’m the coolest teacher you know.
lines.zh: : 大概因为我是你认识的最酷的老师吧。

lines.en: : Hahahaha! No, really though. How’d you do it?
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈！不是，说真的。你怎么做到的？

lines.en: : Am I...
: Am I not cool to you?
lines.zh: : 我对你来说不酷吗？

lines.en: scene nodokaotohapark19
: Ah, wait! I wasn’t trying to be mean! I just thought you were joking!
lines.zh: : 啊，等等！我不是故意要说刻薄话的！我只是以为你在开玩笑！

lines.en: : Maybe it’s better if you don’t transfer in after all...
lines.zh: : 也许你还是别转过来了……

lines.en: : No no no no, hold on! I’d {i}love{/i} to get out of my house, I just don’t really know if it would be a good idea.
lines.zh: : 不不不不，等等！我{i}很想{/i}搬出家门的，我只是不确定这是不是个好主意。

lines.en: scene nodokaotohapark20
: It just sounds a little too good to be true, you know?
lines.zh: : 只是这听起来好得有点不真实，你懂吧？

lines.en: : Like, I don’t want to go through the effort of talking my parents into letting me transfer and...having to leave again if I can’t keep up.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我不想费那么大力气说服我爸妈让我转学，然后……万一跟不上又得离开。

lines.en: : Plus, getting them to let me move into a dorm would be like, a completely different conversation.
lines.zh: : 而且，要让他们同意我搬进宿舍，那完全是另一场谈判了。

lines.en: : It’s just way too much to do for something that I can't guarantee will actually work out.
lines.zh: : 为了一件我没法保证真能成的事，要做的实在太多了。

lines.en: : Sounds to me like someone is scared.
lines.zh: : 听起来有人是害怕了。

lines.en: : Kind of, yeah. I’m not really hiding that.
lines.zh: : 有点吧，是啊。我也没打算藏着。

lines.en: : It would be awesome if I could spend more time practicing my singing and stuff but like, some people just aren’t meant to do that.
lines.zh: : 如果我能有更多时间练歌什么的当然很棒，不过呢，有些人就是天生没那个命。

lines.en: : Do you not believe the thing about getting A’s for doing literally nothing?
lines.zh: : 你是不相信什么都不干就能拿 A 这件事吗？

lines.en: scene nodokaotohapark10
: Not really.
lines.zh: : 不太信。

lines.en: : Nodoka, is that true?
lines.zh: : Nodoka，是真的吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know. I haven’t transferred in yet.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我还没转进去呢。

lines.en: : How is saying that helping you accomplish your goal? Just lie to her.
lines.zh: : 你这么说对实现目标有什么帮助？骗她不就行了。

lines.en: : I don’t need to. I already know what she’s going to do.
lines.zh: : 我不需要。我已经知道她会怎么做了。

lines.en: : You’re tired of staying at home, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你已经受够了待在家里，对吧？

lines.en: : I know what it’s like to feel trapped. You can’t create in an environment like that.
lines.zh: : 我知道被困住是什么感觉。在那种环境里你是没法创作的。

lines.en: : The best thing for you is to truly experience freedom. And to do that, you must escape the cage.
lines.zh: : 对你来说最好的事，就是真正地体验自由。而要做到这一点，你必须逃出笼子。

lines.en: : Mend your broken wings and fly higher than you’ve ever flown before.
lines.zh: : 治好你折断的翅膀，飞得比以往任何时候都高。

lines.en: : Also, if you and Rin start dating, that means I get to-
lines.zh: : 另外，如果你和 Rin 开始交往，那就意味着我可以——

lines.en: scene nodokaotohapark21
: Okay! Yeah! I’ll try talking to my parents! Just get her to stop talking!
lines.zh: : 好！行！我会去跟我爸妈说的！快让她别说了！

lines.en: : {i}Yuritopia awaits...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}百合乌托邦在等着我们……{/i}

lines.en: : Do you need any help? I’m not really great at talking to parents apart from single moms.
lines.zh: : 需要帮忙吗？除了单亲妈妈之外，我其实不太擅长跟家长说话。

lines.en: : First off, what?! Second, no! I’ll be fine!
lines.zh: : 首先，你说什么？！其次，不用！我自己能行！

lines.en: : I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : You’re really sure about the A’s thing, right?
lines.zh: : 你真的确定给 A 那件事，对吧？

lines.en: : Because if you can like, {i}really{/i} promise me that, I can probably make a deal with them.
lines.zh: : 因为如果你{i}真的{/i}能向我保证，我大概就能和他们谈成一笔交易。

lines.en: : Of course. If there is one thing you can trust me with, it is your grades.
lines.zh: : 当然。如果有什么事是我值得你信任的，那就是你的成绩。

lines.en: : That’s the one area I’ve yet to let anyone down in so far.
lines.zh: : 这是迄今为止我唯一还没让任何人失望过的领域。

lines.en: : Well, second counting-
lines.zh: : 嗯，算上第二个的话——

lines.en: scene nodokaotohapark22
: C-Conversation over! You two win! I already said I’ll talk to them!
lines.zh: : 谈……谈话结束了！你们俩赢了！我都说了我会去跟他们谈的！

lines.en: : Ohohoho...what’s the other thing you haven’t let anyone down in, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 哦呵呵呵……另一个你还没让任何人失望过的领域是什么，Sensei？

lines.en: : Well...You see, Nodoka, if there is any area I’m confident in, it’s-
lines.zh: : 嗯……你看，Nodoka，如果有什么领域是我很有自信的，那就是——

lines.en: : Oooooooookay, I’m out. Congrats on your new boyfriend, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 好——了——吧，我走了。祝贺你有了新男友，Nodoka。

lines.en: scene nodokaotohapark23
: And congratulations to you on your future girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 也祝贺你有了未来的女朋友。

lines.en: : Shut up. We’re just friends.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。我们只是朋友。

lines.en: : And stop trying to hook me up with people. It literally never works.
lines.zh: : 还有别再想把我和别人凑一对了。这招从来就没成功过。

lines.en: : I don’t have to try anything this time. You’ve got it handled all on your own.
lines.zh: : 这次我什么都不用做。你自己就搞定了。

lines.en: : You’re such a big girl now, Otoha. I’m so proud.
lines.zh: : 你现在真是个大女孩了，Otoha。我真为你骄傲。

lines.en: : I’ll text you later about what my parents say.
lines.zh: : 我爸妈怎么说，我晚点发消息告诉你。

lines.en: : They might need to sleep on it, though.
lines.zh: : 不过他们可能得先考虑一晚上。

lines.en: : I’ll begin making the arrangements for us to room together.
lines.zh: : 我就开始安排我们住一间的事了。

lines.en: : Unless perhaps you’d like to swap places with Futaba and sleep in the same room as Rin.
lines.zh: : 除非你想和 Futaba 换一下，跟 Rin 睡一间。

lines.en: : That way, we can all be happy.
lines.zh: : 那样的话，我们大家就都能幸福了。

lines.en: scene nodokaotohapark22
: Do whatever you want. I’ll be fine either way.
lines.zh: : 你爱怎么安排都行。我怎样都无所谓。

lines.en: : And uhh...thanks, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 还有呃……谢谢你，Sensei。

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == False:
: Rin was right about you being a really cool guy.
lines.zh: : Rin 说得对，你确实是个很酷的人。

lines.en: else:
: This is...really cool of you.
lines.zh: : 你这样做……真的很酷。

lines.en: : But I’m...gonna get going now. I have to be home in half an hour anyway.
lines.zh: : 不过我……要走了。反正半小时内我得到家。

lines.en: : Fly free, little bird.
lines.zh: : 自由地飞吧，小鸟。

lines.en: : How? Aren’t her wings supposed to be broken?
lines.zh: : 怎么飞？她的翅膀不是断了吗？

lines.en: : Shhh...she’s off to a better place now.
lines.zh: : 嘘……她现在去往更好的地方了。

lines.en: scene black
: But that just makes it sound like she’s dead...
lines.zh: : 可那听起来像她死了一样……

lines.en: : Ahh! What’s with this weird chemistry between you two?!
lines.zh: : 啊啊！你们俩这奇怪的默契是怎么回事啊？！

lines.en: Otoha gets off the bench and storms away from Nodoka and me, grabbing a large black and red backpack in the process.
lines.zh: Otoha 从长椅上站起来，气冲冲地离开了 Nodoka 和我，顺手抓起一个黑红相间的大背包。

lines.en: : It’s because we’re soulmates.
lines.zh: : 因为我们是灵魂伴侣。

lines.en: : I’ll create a Facebook invite for our first time and send it over as soon as I-
lines.zh: : 我会为我们的第一次创建一个脸书邀请，然后马上发过——

lines.en: : No thanks! Bye!
lines.zh: : 不用了！再见！

lines.en: : Do I gain any more Nodoka points for succeeding today?
lines.zh: : 今天成功了，我能再得点 Nodoka 点数吗？

lines.en: : You can have five more. Congratulations, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 可以再给你五个。恭喜你，Sensei。

lines.en: : You really need to start awarding more points for things...
lines.zh: : 你真该开始多给点分了……

lines.zh: {i}Otoha 的好感度提升到了 [otoha_love]！{/i}
